name: EAR YOGA
trialStarts: first launch on device; countdown preserved across updates
notes: Mobile release 1.53: Exact user-selected cover Variant3 (Cormorant / Forum, original lotus and positioned Manrope Settings), with locally cached fonts. Choose route opens the interactive planetary journey map. Each world offers a random flight or a route carousel. Five-star best results and completed-route percentages are saved separately from proficiency achievements; planet ratings average completed routes. Natural drag, overhead view, zoom, no Saturn rings, seven vertical jewel awards and a consistent wordmark. Existing harmony, audio, terrain, Teacher +7%, Student flying notes and saved progress are preserved.
